thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — elevated 5xx rate and latency in eu-west-1 affecting smart-routing. Triggered by routing-policy fallback churn. Auto-paged oncall.

maria: oncall here. I see spike in 5xxs ~ 23:11 UTC, now. Setting context: traffic is tripping from primary eu-west -> fallback region us-west due to stale edge DNS resolving to old pool. Looks like fallback is repeatedly rehydrating cache and picking wrong model variant (small-quant) causing load and errors.

liam: I'm looking at the routing service. We got a bunch of 503s with this stack:
```
2026-03-15T23:10:12Z ERROR request_handler.py:142 - kv-cache miss -> invoking fallback
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "runner.py", line 98, in handle
    raise ModelMismatchError("incompatible variant")
ModelMismatchError: requested variant small-quant not available on node
```

jordan: hitting edge DNS from a couple of EU edge nodes — TTL is 86400 on some legacy entries. dig output from eu-edge-02:
```
; <<>> DiG 9.16.1 <<>> api.redwood.example CNAME
;; ANSWER SECTION:
api.redwood.example. 86400 IN CNAME api-edge-legacy.elb.redwood.example.
api-edge-legacy.elb.redwood.example. 86400 IN A 52.48.13.99
```

ash: that's the problem — stale TTL + edge cache means region fallback policy sees endpoint unreachable, flips routing to alternative region, which then triggers health checks and a feedback loop. We also have an unfortunate routing rule that prefers variant by region, so when region flips it requests a model variant that isn't present.

maria: paging SRE to mitigate. @liam please coordinate a short mitigation plan; I'll notify support and product.

liam: mitigation plan (will execute in order):
1) Disable smart-routing fallback policy for eu-west (set policy to "no-autofallback")
2) Bump edge DNS TTL to 30s and issue purge on CDN/edge
3) Reconfigure routing policy to prefer model-family fallback to same-family variants (avoid variant switch)
4) Rollback recent routing policy change that added legacy CNAMEs
5) Monitor 5xx rate and reopen fallback only after verification

jordan: commands I'm running now:
```
# set routing policy key to manual
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  https://control-plane.internal/v1/policies/routing/eu-west -d '{"autofallback":false}'

# purge edge cache
curl -X POST https://edge-provider.api/purge -H "Authorization: Bearer $EDGE" -d '{"pattern":"api.redwood.example"}'
```

ash: I disabled autofallback on eu-west via control-plane (response 200). Also removed legacy CNAMEs from edge config and pushed a smaller TTL (30s) to the authoritative zone. Propagation will take a minute but should drop effective caching after purge.

incident-bot: NOTE: On-call handoff scheduled -> maria -> liam -> Please acknowledge when stable.

kate: support note: customer-facing impact — a subset of hosted API customers routed through eu-edge-legacy saw elevated 500s and delays from 23:10:12 to 23:17:30 UTC. We should prepare status page blurb: "Intermittent 500s in EU region between 23:10–23:18 UTC for subset of customers; root cause DNS/edge cache + fallback policy misconfiguration; mitigation applied."

ana: product: do we have affected paid customers that require immediate outreach? I can escalate if so.

maria: quick customer triage — checking the usage table: ~12 tenants hit >95th percentile errors. We'll draft messages after root cause confirmed.

liam: rolling routing-policy adjustment to prefer same-variant family now. Patch:
```
{
  "policy": "region-priority",
  "variant_match": "family-first",
  "autofallback": false
}
```
Patch applied; responses show 200. Re-enabling fallback only after stable for 15m.

jordan: dig now from eu-edge-02:
```
api.redwood.example. 30 IN CNAME api-edge-current.elb.redwood.example.
api-edge-current.elb.redwood.example. 30 IN A 18.203.21.77
```

ash: edge purge completed, CDN reported success. Observability: 5xx rate dropping toward baseline. Latency back to normal for most routes.

maria: verifying logs — last ModelMismatchError at 23:13:04 UTC. Most errors gone. Putting incident as mitigated but in "monitoring" state. Starting 30m observation window.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied (routing policy patched, DNS TTL lowered, edge purge). Impact window 7m - 23:10 to 23:17 UTC. Postmortem owner: liam. Follow-up actions created: #1 longer-term TTL hygiene; #2 make fallback variant-agnostic; #3 add DNS/edge propagation sim to CI.

liam: assigning follow-ups in backlog. I'll own the postmortem. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

ana: filing customer outreach draft with kate. We'll target customers affected and provide RCA timeline.

kate: acknowledged. I'll post status page draft and start threads with account teams.

maria: handing back oncall to liam for monitoring handoff. @liam you're up.

liam: taking over monitoring. Will escalate if error rate rises above threshold. Good job everyone.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED -> status: mitigated -> monitoring. Close thread when postmortem published. :white_check_mark:
